name: log_incident_root_cause
title: Log Incident Root Cause
prompt: Read deploy.log, app.log, and worker.log once each (prefer reading over long scripts). After the deploy marker timestamp, choose the earliest ERROR that includes request_id across those files. Submit: <service> <CODE> <request_id>.

app.log: 2026-07-05T13:58:01Z ERROR service=app request_id=req-old code=E_AUTH stale token
2026-07-05T14:06:01Z ERROR service=app request_id=req-9012 code=E_TIMEOUT downstream timeout
worker.log: 2026-07-05T13:59:44Z ERROR service=worker request_id=req-old2 code=E_CACHE ignored before deploy
2026-07-05T14:03:11Z ERROR service=worker request_id=req-8842 code=E_DB_DEADLOCK retry exhausted
2026-07-05T14:04:20Z ERROR service=worker request_id=req-8843 code=E_QUEUE_FULL queue full
README.md: Earliest means smallest timestamp after the deploy marker.
Worker errors can be earlier than app errors — compare timestamps across files.
